lines.en: And if Harry's not better by Friday,
we'll have to cancel our shows in San Francisco.
Well, I feel awful. I don't know why he's not getting better.
Carly. Oh, sweet, innocent, stupid little Carly.
Harry doesn't want to get better
'cause you make him breakfast in bed and you warm his socks
and read him stories and brush his hair and, you know, you're not ugly.
What do you think, hot pants?
Well, if you were treating me like you've been treating Harry,
I sure wouldn't want to leave.
I'm not faking. I'm sure he was sick.
I just think now he's having a good time at Hotel Carly-for-nia.
You did not just say that.
- I said it and I'm proud of it. - Oh, whoa.
OK, so what are we going to do about this?
Uh, I know what might motivate Harry to get out of bed and back on stage.
You think I should work him over with a butter sock?
You know, I really, really don't.
Is that a sock full of butter?
- Do you guys want to hear my idea? - Yes.
Does it involve the butter sock?
Look, I was just thinking Harry might suddenly feel better if he thought he was going to be replaced in One Direction.
Well, not for real. We just make him think he's being replaced.
Baby, you light up my world like nobody else.
The way that you lift your head gets me overwhelmed.
You really think you can perform?
- You're not even wearing a watch. - Well, I'll be ready.
Just please don't let him sing...
- That worked. It really worked. - It worked great.
Your smile comes alive in anticipation.
- I wanna see, I wanna see! - OK!
You made me look worse than I did when I got here.
Our story can't just end like this!
We need some kind of resolution!
'Tis the moment you've been waiting for.
You're turning heads when you walk through the door.
Being the way that you are is enough.
Everyone else in the room can see it.
Baby, you light up my world like nobody else.
The way that you flip your head lets me overwhelmed.
But when you smile at the ground, it ain't hard to tell.
If only you saw what I can see.
You'll understand why I want you so desperately.
Right now I'm looking at you and I can't believe you don't know.
So, come on, you got it wrong to prove I'm right.
I put it in a song.
I don't know why you're being shy and turn away when I look into your eyes.
Everyone else in the room can see it.
Oh, baby, you light up my world like nobody else.
The way that you flip your head gets me overwhelmed.
The way that you smile at the ground, it ain't hard to tell.
